summary: The number of young people in the labor force grows by about two million from April to July.
realLife: The youth labor force grew by 2.1 million from April (21.4 million) to July (23.5 million) as students looked for summer jobs and graduates entered the workforce.
sources: Bureau of Labor Statistics, Employment and Unemployment Among Youth, Summer 2026: https://www.bls.gov/news.release/youth.nr0.htm
